newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Home Health Corp upped.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Home Health Corp upped.

text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist said its analyst Robert Lunbeck raised his earnings estimates for Home Health Corp of America following what Lunbeck called a "strong Q2" earnings report.
-- Lunbeck said he raised his fiscal 1997, ending June 30, earnings estimate to $0.78/shr from $0.76 and his fiscal 1998 estimate to $0.94 from $0.92.
-- Lunbeck said he based the higher ratings "in part on higher sustainable internal growth of 12 to 15 pct."
